targets: Surface/root-zone soil moisture; terrestrial water storage; groundwater
reference_data: ISMN/COSMOS and profile networks; wells and lysimeters; GRACE as a separate retrieval reference
temporal_spatial_support: Hourly to seasonal; point, footprint, pixel and basin
transfer_tests: Station, basin, soil, biome and drought-period holdouts
diagnostics: Bias, ubRMSE and correlation; depth/scale sensitivity; water-balance residual; interval coverage

targets: LST; evapotranspiration; transpiration; sensible and latent heat
reference_data: Eddy-covariance towers; scintillometers; lysimeters; thermal validation sites
temporal_spatial_support: Half-hourly to daily; tower footprint to satellite pixel
transfer_tests: Tower, season, climate, irrigation and heatwave holdouts
diagnostics: Bias and RMSE; phase and extremes; energy closure; ET partitioning; calibration

targets: GPP; respiration; NEE; WUE; biomass and soil carbon
reference_data: FLUXNET partitioned fluxes; inventories and harvests; field/LiDAR biomass; soil profiles
temporal_spatial_support: Half-hourly to annual; plot, tower, pixel and biome
transfer_tests: Site, biome, year, sensor and drought holdouts
diagnostics: Bias and RMSE; seasonal phase; partition sensitivity; GPP-ET/WUE coupling; carbon balance; stock-flux distinction

targets: VWC/LFMC; canopy temperature; phenology; crop stress
reference_data: Field water-content campaigns; thermal sensors; PhenoCam; crop and forest observations
temporal_spatial_support: Daily to seasonal; plant, field, canopy and pixel
transfer_tests: Species, crop, region, calendar and compound-stress holdouts
diagnostics: Onset lead time; event F1; hysteresis and recovery; false-alert rate; calibrated probability

targets: Streamflow; runoff regime; snow water; storage anomaly
reference_data: Stream gauges; snow networks; groundwater wells; reservoir-operation records
temporal_spatial_support: Hourly to annual; hillslope, reach and catchment
transfer_tests: Ungauged basin, hydroclimate, regulated basin and extreme-event holdouts
diagnostics: NSE/KGE and bias; peak timing; low/high flows; continuity and closure; regime-conditioned error

targets: Flood, fire and drought extent/severity; ecosystem impact and recovery
reference_data: Event maps plus gauges, field severity, damage, flux and vegetation-recovery observations
temporal_spatial_support: Event to multiyear; object, pixel, catchment and landscape
transfer_tests: Event, geography, sensor, pre/post period and compound-extreme holdouts
diagnostics: IoU/F1 plus severity error; lead time; recovery trajectory; impact attribution; uncertainty coverage
